name: keyfence
desc: Keeps secrets from leaking out of AI coding agent sessions, and keeps them organized in a local vault
author: candiani
typing: Paste a token in the chat and keep working
Saved as a credential: service, account, login, password
Finds the keys already on your disk and files them
Blocked from curl, commits, MCP and tracked files
tagline: A Claude Code hook and local vault: it catches every credential that enters a session, files it by name, and stops it at every exit.
pitch: **keyfence** treats every credential that enters an agent session as tainted and files it as a credential: pasted in the prompt, printed by a command or already sitting in a `.env`, it gets a record in an encrypted local vault (`sis/robson`: login and password), a name the agent uses (`$SIS_ROBSON_PASSWORD`), and a hard stop at every exit, whether that exit is a `curl`, a commit, an MCP tool or a hardcoded config.
notice: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. "Claude" and "Claude Code" are Anthropic trademarks.

what.product: Claude Code hook plus a local vault that keeps credentials in and organized
what.capture: a credential pasted in any form becomes a record: service, account, login, password
what.detects: 53 formats · labeled values · ?key= links · contextual classifier
what.vault: AES-256-GCM, master key in the macOS Keychain, no command that prints a value
what.organize: discover finds keys on disk · tidy renames old ones · maintain runs daily
what.out: denied to the network, commits, non-local tools, source files and git-tracked files
what.output: tool output reaches the agent with the name in place of the value
what.privacy: the classifier only ever sees the shape of a value (aaa999), never the value
